statement: The pinned HIDMaestro adapter persona implements a 214-byte HID report descriptor alongside a one-configuration, one-interface USB/IP model with interrupt IN 0x81 (37 bytes) and OUT 0x02 (5 bytes), both at interval 8. This records an open-source emulation expectation, not a new retail descriptor observation. The two archived enumeration dumps expose a descriptor length of 214 bytes but do not print its contents.

applicability.revision: public reports for 0x057e:0x0337; hardware revision unverified
applicability.scope: HIDMaestro emulator descriptor model versus published host enumeration; exact retail HID bytes remain unverified
